title: MACARONI PIE
instructions: Put the macaroni on to boil in plenty of cold water with an onion. Let it boil gently until the macaroni is quite tender, then throw it on a sieve to drain; but first wash it in cold water. Then put on half a pint of cream to boil with about four onces of grated Parmesan cheese, a tablespoonful of mustard, a little cayenne pepper,  salt and butter. Thin it in some macaroni, and let it stew gently a few minutes. Have some grated cheese mixed with a few bread crumbs. Put the macaroni in a deep dish, sprinkle the crumbs of cheese over the top and bake it. --MRS. PHILLIPS (Dr. Arnold's Receipt).
